title: ValueWeave ProvenanceRecord
description: The canonical 8-field provenance model shared by every ValueWeave package since Package001_Geography. Mirrors knowledge_engine/core/provenance.py's ProvenanceRecord dataclass.

source.description: Human-readable description of the source, e.g. 'data.gov.in Open Government Data Platform'.

source_url.description: One or more URLs the fact was drawn from.

collection_date.description: The date this fact was first collected (ISO 8601).

last_verified.description: The date this fact was last re-checked against its source. Equals collection_date until a re-verification pass updates it.

collector.description: The name and version of the Collector/Parser pipeline that produced this record, e.g. 'csv_collector.CSVCollector/0.1.0'.

confidence.description: Confidence score calibrated per core.types.ConfidenceTier: 70-100 government-grade, 55-69 portal/news, 0-54 community/qualitative.

verification_status.description: Every record is created at VST-NEEDS_REVIEW. Promotion to VST-VERIFIED is a governance action, never automatic.

package_version.description: The semantic version of the package this record was collected for/into. Null while still in staging.

notes.description: Free-text context. Required whenever any field on the parent record holds the PENDING_VERIFICATION sentinel, formatted '[field_name]: explanation'.
